heading: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
translated_text:
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

REGIONAL REGULATION OF BONTANG CITY

NUMBER 9 OF 2012

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

BY THE GRACE OF ALMIGHTY GOD

THE MAYOR OF BONTANG,

Considering:

a. that women and children biologically and philosophically are groups vulnerable to acts of violence, both violence occurring within the household and that committed outside the household;
b. that protection of women and children victims of violence is one aspect of the duties and responsibilities of the government in providing protection and services to the community;
c. that based on the considerations as referred to in letters a and b, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation on Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence;

In View of:

1. Article 18 paragraph (6) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia;
2. Law Number 47 of 1999 concerning the Establishment of Nunukan Regency, Malinau Regency, West Kutai Regency, East Kutai Regency and Bontang City (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 1999 Number 175, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 3839) as amended by Law Number 7 of 2000 (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2000 Number 74 Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 3962);
3. Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2004 Number 125, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4437) as last amended by Law Number 12 of 2008 (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2008 Number 59, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4844);

With Mutual Approval of

THE REGIONAL HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES OF BONTANG CITY

and

THE MAYOR OF BONTANG

HAS DECIDED:

To Establish:

REGIONAL REGULATION ON PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE.

heading: CHAPTER I
translated_text:
CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is Bontang City.
2. Regional Government is the Mayor and regional apparatus as elements of the Regional Government administration.
3. Head of Region is the Mayor of Bontang.
4. Regional Apparatus Work Unit hereinafter abbreviated as SKPD is the Regional Apparatus of Bontang City Government.
5. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an Integrated Service Unit established by the Regional Government to provide services to women and children victims of violence comprehensively including information services, assistance and legal aid, counseling services, medical services and safe houses through referral.
6. Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age, including those in the womb.
7. General Hospital is a service facility that provides basic and specialist medical services, medical support services, installation services and care services on an outpatient and inpatient basis.
8. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, psychological to the victim.
9. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
10. Service is an action that must be immediately taken to the victim when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or occurred violence against the victim.
11. Companion is a person or representative of an institution who has the expertise to accompany victims to conduct counseling, therapy and advocacy to provide strengthening and recovery of victims of violence as determined in a decision of an authorized official.
12. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy and spiritual guidance for self-strengthening of victims of domestic violence to resolve the problems faced.
13. Victim Recovery is all actions to strengthen victims of domestic violence to be more empowered, both physically and psychologically.
14. Implementation of Recovery is all actions that include services and assistance to victims of domestic violence.
15. Cooperation is a systematic and integrated method among recovery implementers in providing services to recover victims of domestic violence.
16. Safe House is a temporary residence used to provide protection to victims in accordance with determined operational standards.
17. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and or community organizations.
18. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband, wife and their children or father and his children and mother and her children or blood relatives in direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.
19. Household is family members and relatives (grandchildren, nieces/nephews, siblings, grandparents, cousins and so on) and non-relatives (housemaids, drivers and so on) who live and eat from one kitchen and reside in one house.
20. Household Scope is people who have family relations with persons as referred to in number 19 due to blood relations, marriage, breastfeeding, foster care, guardianship who reside in the household as well as people who work to help the household and reside in that household.

heading: CHAPTER II
Article 3
translated_text:
Article 3

The objective of protection of women and children victims of violence is to provide protection and services for the best interests of victims occurring in the household and or public.

Article 7

heading: CHAPTER V
translated_text:
CHAPTER V

OBLIGATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Article 12

The obligations and responsibilities in providing protection to women and children victims of acts of violence are the joint responsibility of:
a. Regional Government;
b. Community; and
c. Family and/or parents.

heading: Article 13
Article 14
Article 15
translated_text:
Article 15

The obligations of family and/or parents as referred to in Article 6 letter c, legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of acts of violence and protect women and children as family members.

heading: CHAPTER VI
Article 17
translated_text:
Article 17

In implementing efforts to prevent acts of violence against women and children, the Regional Government must take into account the rights and obligations of parents, guardians, husbands or other persons legally responsible for the victim.

heading: Article 30
translated_text:
Article 30

1. Integrated services for women and children victims of violence shall be carried out based on:
a. the initiative of the Regional Government itself or technically by related SKPD either directly or indirectly; or
b. at the request and complaint of the victim, applicant, companion, family, other persons, community organizations, social organizations or non-governmental organizations who know.
2. Integrated services carried out by P2TP2A shall be carried out based on referrals from service institutions or based on complaints from victims or their families;
3. Provisions regarding procedures and procedures for obtaining P2TP2A services in a Mayor Regulation.

heading: CHAPTER VIII
CHAPTER IX
translated_text:
CHAPTER IX

IMPLEMENTATION OF ASSISTANCE

Article 32

1. Assistance is carried out by persons or institutions that have expertise in conducting counseling, therapy, and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence;
2. Assistance carried out by persons or institutions as referred to in paragraph (1) must coordinate with P2TP2A.

heading: CHAPTER X
translated_text:
CHAPTER X

HANDLING OF CHILDREN IN CONFLICT WITH THE LAW

Article 33

Handling of children in conflict with the law includes:
a. children as perpetrators;
b. children as victims; and
c. children as witnesses to criminal acts.

heading: Article 38
CHAPTER XII

CHAPTER XII

FUNDING

Article 39

1. Funds for the implementation of protection of women and children victims of acts of violence managed by P2TP2A must be allocated in the Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget;
2. In addition to the budget sources as referred to in paragraph (1), funds for the implementation of protection of women and children victims of acts of violence may also be sourced from other legitimate and non-binding budgets.

heading: CHAPTER XIII

Article 42
